themes.name: Quarry & Aureole
themes.description: Raw structural weight meets a single blade of soft morning radiance — Swiss grid precision anchoring an ethereal image-first composition.

props.text: Raw stone. One blade of gold light. The grid holds everything — until the image breaks free.
Stone holds the light it never shows.
Swiss grid precision. A single aureole at dawn. Structure and softness, unresolved.

themes.name: Fired & Resting
themes.description: A late-night riad courtyard rendered as editorial print — mineral blues and baked terracotta held in generous white, pattern dissolved into measured rhythm.

props.text: Riad at two in the morning. Mineral blue climbing terracotta. The pattern knows when to stop.

themes.name: Gilt Frequency
themes.description: Art Deco glamour filtered through a late-night CRT glow — geometric gold type cutting across deep lacquered surfaces with the precision of a Chrysler Building spire.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Geometric gold cuts across lacquered dark like a Chrysler spire splitting midnight static. High contrast. Zero apology.

themes.name: Spill & Sprawl
themes.description: A sun-drenched backyard tableau where faded magenta and lawn green collide on cream — energetic scattered cards breathing in generous open air.

props.text: Cards tossed across a cream afternoon. Magenta bleeds into lawn green — loud, loose, and gloriously uncontained.
Sun-drenched and sprawling across a cream afternoon.

themes.name: Tin Shore
themes.description: A Baltic harbour index — fogged linen ground, cold grotesk structure, one unmistakable red accent cutting through disciplined mist.

props.text: Fog doesn't obscure — it disciplines. One red cuts the mist like a buoy light. Everything else holds the line.

themes.name: Velvet Measure
themes.description: A gallery composition drawn from jazz club geometry — warm tarnished surfaces, cinematic image presence, and a typographic rhythm that swings between condensed authority and open serif grace.

props.text: Where the brass is tarnished and the lights are low — geometry swings between condensed authority and open serif grace.
Jazz club geometry — warm, cinematic, alive.

themes.name: Eave & Meridian
themes.description: A Brazilian modernist terrace at first light — wide overhangs, rosewood type, and a palette of canopy green and terracotta held in cool interior shadow.

props.text: A Brazilian modernist terrace at first light — wide overhangs casting cool interior shadow over rosewood type, canopy green and terracotta breathing together in the quiet before noon.
Rosewood links animate beneath Karla's quiet geometry, grounded against canopy shadow.
